text:
The fix works. All tests pass, and the issue examples now return correct values:
- `to_int("IV")` → 4 (was 6)
- `to_int("IX")` → 9 (was 11)
- `to_int("XLII")` → 42 (was 82)
- `to_int("MCMXC")` → 1990 (multiple subtractive pairs work)
- Case-insensitivity and whitespace handling still work

The change was a one-character fix in `roman/numerals.py`: the subtractive branch of the loop was doing `total += value` instead of `total -= value`, so subtractive pairs were being added rather than subtracted.
